text: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普加大了对美联储降息的施压，他甚至威胁说若央行按兵不动自己就要切断和逆差对象国的贸易。 特朗普周五在自家社交媒体Truth Social上发帖说：“下调利率，否则我就停止与那些我们有逆差的国家贸易，这是美国最高法院在它荒谬且代价高昂的关税裁决中强烈认可‘总统’绝对有权力做的。这比关税还好！美联储理事会有了很棒的新领导了，必须学聪明起来，变成爱国者吧。高利率让美国陷于非常不公平的劣势地位，而我绝不会允许那种事情发生！”
text_en: U.S. President Donald Trump intensified pressure on the Federal Reserve to cut interest rates, even threatening to halt trade with countries running surpluses against the U.S. if the central bank stays put. In a post on his social media platform Truth Social on Friday, Trump said: "Cut rates, or I will stop trading with countries with which we have a deficit—an absolute power the 'President' is strongly endorsed to have by the Supreme Court in its ridiculous and costly tariff ruling. This is even better than tariffs! With great new leadership at the Fed, they must get smart and become patriots. High rates put America at a very unfair disadvantage, and I will never allow that to happen!"
